scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile full --profile tunnel --profile tunnel-ngrok down
scripts.stack:seed: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile full run --rm migrate node dist/db/seed.js
scripts.stack:seed:dev: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile full run --rm migrate node dist/db/seed.js --dev
